snippet.title: 🐦 Not All Birds Sing! Surprising Facts About Silent Species
snippet.description:
We all think of birds as beautiful singers, right? 🎶 But prepare for a surprising truth! In this Quirble, we dive into the world of birds that actually CAN'T sing or even whistle.

You might be shocked to learn that many species, like most **vultures**, **storks**, and **pelicans**, lack the complex vocal organ called the **syrinx**. This means they can't produce those lovely melodies we associate with birds. Instead, their communication involves unique sounds like hisses, clacks, or grunts!

This fact challenges our common perception and shows just how diverse the avian world truly is.

Did this fact surprise you? Let us know in the comments below! 👇
